sharedRules.name: Pistol
sharedRules.description:
- **Restriction:** Weapon rule
- **Result:**
  - **[PISTOL]** = **[CLOSE-QUARTERS]** for every purpose
  - Unit with ≥1 model with a **[CLOSE-QUARTERS]** weapon: may use **close-quarters shooting**
  - Different **shooting type**: each model (excluding **MONSTER/VEHICLE**) attacks with only one group:
  -   - **[CLOSE-QUARTERS]** weapons (≥1)
  -   - remaining ranged weapons (≥1)

sharedRules.name: Hazardous
sharedRules.description:
- **Timing:** a unit that was **selected to shoot** / **selected to fight** has finished resolving its attacks
- **Result:** count the **[HAZARDOUS]** weapons you chose at the Select Weapons step; the unit makes that many **hazard rolls**

sharedRules.name: Leader
sharedRules.description:
- **Timing:** Muster Armies step, pre-battle
- **Select:** Each leader or support unit of yours picks 1× friendly bodyguard unit it can lead (optional)
- **Result:**
  - It leads that bodyguard unit all battle; together they form an attached unit
  - Default cap per bodyguard unit: 1 leader unit + 1 support unit

sharedRules.name: Devastating Wounds
sharedRules.description:
- **Timing:** A **[DEVASTATING WOUNDS]** attack makes a **critical wound**
- **Result:**
  - Attack sequence halts
  - Target takes **mortal wounds** = weapon **D** characteristic, after regular damage
  - **Mortal wounds** from this: max 1 model damaged per **critical wound**; extra ones vanish

sharedRules.name: Assault
sharedRules.description: **[ASSAULT]** weapon on ≥1 model: its unit may use **assault shooting**.

sharedRules.name: Extra Attacks
sharedRules.description:
- **Timing:** Unit having ≥1 model with an **[EXTRA ATTACKS]** weapon fights
- **Result:**
  - Those weapons attack alongside the models' other weapons
  - Select Weapons step, each such model must pick:
  -   - every **[EXTRA ATTACKS]** weapon it has
  -   - 1× other melee weapon, where available

sharedRules.name: Twin-linked
sharedRules.description:
- **Restriction:** weapons with **[TWIN-LINKED]**
- **Result:** the **wound roll** of each attack with it may be re-rolled

sharedRules.name: Anti
sharedRules.description:
- **Restriction:** always expressed as **[ANTI-X Y+]**, X being a keyword
- **Result:** unmodified **wound roll** of **Y+** gives a **critical wound** when an **[ANTI]** weapon attacks a unit carrying keyword **X**

sharedRules.name: Sustained Hits
sharedRules.description:
- **Restriction:** appears as **[SUSTAINED HITS X]**, on weapons
- **Timing:** an attack with a **[SUSTAINED HITS]** weapon scores a **critical hit**
- **Result:** that attack scores **X** extra hits on its target, on top of the **critical hit** itself

sharedRules.name: Heavy
sharedRules.description:
- **Restriction:** **[HEAVY]** weapons, Shooting phase of yours
- **Condition:** three things at once: attacker is **unengaged**; it did not arrive via set-up this turn; No model in it has Moved beyond 3" this turn
- **Result:** attack gets +1 on the **hit roll**

sharedRules.name: Melta
sharedRules.description:
- **Restriction:** appears as **[MELTA X]**, on weapons
- **Timing:** a model attacks with a **[MELTA]** weapon
- **Condition:** at the Select Targets step, the chosen unit stood at no more than half of the weapon’s range
- **Result:** weapon’s **D** characteristic rises by **X**
- **Duration:** until the attacker’s attacks finish resolving

sharedRules.name: Feel No Pain
sharedRules.description:
- **Restriction:** written **Feel No Pain X+**; carried by models
- **Timing:** a wound is about to be lost by such a model
- **Result:** 1D6 roll; **X+** cancels the loss

sharedRules.name: Blast
sharedRules.description:
- **Restriction:** **[BLAST]** weapons (or **[BLAST X]**)
- **Timing:** gathering **attack dice** for the weapon
- **Result:**
  - +1 **attack dice** per full 5 models the target unit had in the Select Targets step
  - with **[BLAST X]**: +**X** **attack dice** per full 5 models instead

sharedRules.name: Precision
sharedRules.description:
- **Restriction:** attacks made with at least one **[PRECISION]** weapon
- **Timing:** Allocation Order step of those attacks
- **Condition:** target unit includes a **CHARACTER** model that is **visible** to an attacking model
- **Select:** the active player may choose 1× allocation group holding such a **visible CHARACTER** model (optional)
- **Result:** the chosen group takes over as current allocation group
- **Duration:** ends at the earlier of: all those attacks resolved, or that **CHARACTER** group **destroyed**

sharedRules.name: Indirect Fire
sharedRules.description:
- **Restriction:** any unit that fields an **[INDIRECT FIRE]** weapon on 1+ of its models
- **Result:** unlocks indirect shooting for that unit's shooting

sharedRules.name: Lance
sharedRules.description:
- **Restriction:** **[LANCE]** weapons
- **Condition:** the unit of the attacking model performed a **charge move** during the current turn
- **Result:** **wound roll** is boosted by +1

sharedRules.name: Lethal Hits
sharedRules.description:
- **Restriction:** **[LETHAL HITS]** weapons
- **Timing:** an attack scores a **critical hit**
- **Result:** you may make that attack wound its target automatically (optional)

sharedRules.name: Ignores Cover
sharedRules.description:
- **Restriction:** **[IGNORES COVER]** weapons
- **Timing:** each attack
- **Result:** the target gets no **benefit of cover** against it, whatever rule would grant it (e.g. **Stealth**)

sharedRules.name: Rapid Fire
sharedRules.description:
- **Restriction:** weapons only, written **[RAPID FIRE X]**
- **Timing:** gathering **attack dice** for the **[RAPID FIRE]** weapon
- **Condition:** at the Select Targets step the target was no farther than half the weapon's range
- **Result:** **X** extra **attack dice** join the pool

sharedRules.name: Torrent
sharedRules.description: Every attack with a **[TORRENT]** weapon hits its target with no roll needed.

sharedRules.name: Scouts
sharedRules.description:
- **Restriction:** written **Scouts X"**; the unit qualifies only if each of its models has it
- **Timing:** Resolve Pre-battle Abilities step
- **Select:** 1 of 3 options by unit state (optional)
- **Result:**
  - in **strategic reserves**: deploy it at any point of your deployment zone, wholly within it
  - deployment zone of yours, unit wholly within it: a **scout move** is allowed
  - embarked on a **DEDICATED TRANSPORT** standing wholly within that zone, all embarked models having Scouts: the **DEDICATED TRANSPORT** is allowed a **scout move**

sharedRules.name: Infiltrators
sharedRules.description:
- **Restriction:** all models of the unit need it
- **Timing:** deployment
- **Result:** unit may start anywhere on the table that lies beyond 8" (horizontal) of every enemy unit as well as of the enemy deployment zone (optional)

sharedRules.name: Deep Strike
sharedRules.description:
- **Restriction:** all models of this unit need it
- **Timing:** this unit performs an **ingress move**
- **Result:** unit may arrive at any spot beyond 8" (horizontal) of every enemy unit; the enemy deployment zone does not bar it (optional)

sharedRules.name: Deadly Demise
sharedRules.description:
- **Restriction:** appears as **Deadly Demise X**
- **Timing:** one of this unit’s models gets **destroyed**; occurs after any embarked units finished their **emergency disembark moves**
- **Result:** roll 1D6; on 6 that model suffers a **deadly demise**
  - every unit within 6" of it takes **X** **mortal wounds**
  - if **X** is random, roll it once per unit

sharedRules.name: Stealth
sharedRules.description:
- **Restriction:** all models of the unit need it
- **Timing:** ranged attack aimed at the unit
- **Result:** unit enjoys the **benefit of cover** versus that attack

sharedRules.name: Super-Heavy Walker
sharedRules.description:
- **Timing:** any **normal**, **advance** or **fall-back move** by any unit having this ability
- **Result:**
  - movement: its models pass through other models, except **TITANIC** ones (**MONSTER/VEHICLE** models can be crossed)
  - terrain: its models cross **terrain features** parts of height ≤4" horizontally (in any direction across the table, without climbing)
  - optional **MOBILE**: before the move, all its models may gain the **MOBILE** keyword; if so, once the move ends roll 1D6, on 1 the unit becomes battle-shocked
- **Duration:** **MOBILE** from this effect stops when the move ends

sharedRules.name: Lone Operative
sharedRules.description:
- **Restriction:** this unit; no effect while it belongs to an **attached** unit; may be written **Lone Operative X"** (default distance 12")
- **Result:** vs enemy models farther than 12" (or **X"**) from this unit:
  - this unit cannot be seen: it is not **visible** to them
  - **[INDIRECT FIRE]** weapons of an attacker that far away cannot choose it as a target

sharedRules.name: Hover
sharedRules.description:
- **Restriction:** unit with Hover
- **Timing:** **takes to the skies**
- **Result:** **maximum distance** is left intact: no 2" subtraction

sharedRules.name: Fights First
sharedRules.description:
- **Restriction:** unit whose models all possess it
- **Result:** unit counts as **Fights First** (rules: Fight phase, Resolve Fights First Combats step)

sharedRules.name: Psychic
sharedRules.description:
- **Restriction:** **[PSYCHIC]** weapons
- **Timing:** each attack
- **Result:** optionally disregard some or all modifiers affecting the **BS**/**WS** characteristic or the **hit roll**
  - these are **psychic attacks** (matters for other rules)

sharedRules.name: Firing Deck
sharedRules.description:
- **Restriction:** **TRANSPORT** with the form **Firing Deck X**
- **Timing:** your Shooting phase, when this **TRANSPORT** is **selected to shoot**
- **Condition:** it carries 1+ embarked units
- **Select:** in order:
  - 1. up to **X** embarked models, ignoring those whose units were **selected to shoot** already this phase
  - 2. for each of them, 1× ranged weapon, never **[ONE SHOT]**
- **Result:**
  - 3. all those weapons are added to the **TRANSPORT**’s own until its attacks are all resolved
  - 4. embarked units are not eligible to shoot until end of turn

sharedRules.name: One Shot
sharedRules.description:
- **Limits:** each weapon with it: selectable to attack 1× per battle
- **Result:**
  - a **destroyed** model coming back: its **[ONE SHOT]** weapons that fired earlier remain unselectable
  - a new unit joining the army: its **[ONE SHOT]** weapons each get one fresh use

sharedRules.name: Crucible
sharedRules.description:
- **Restriction:** **^^Character^^** made with Crucible rules
- **Limits:** per army, max three units with Crucible; Enhancements cannot go on them
- **Result:** such a **^^Character^^** has the Crucible ability

sharedRules.name: Cleave
sharedRules.description:
- **Restriction:** appears as **[CLEAVE X]**, on weapons
- **Timing:** gathering **attack dice** for a **[CLEAVE]** weapon
- **Condition:** all that weapon’s attacks were aimed at one chosen target
- **Result:** **X** extra **attack dice** per full 5 models the target unit had in the Select Targets step

sharedRules.name: Close-quarters
sharedRules.description:
- **Restriction:** units with 1+ models carrying a **[CLOSE-QUARTERS]** weapon
- **Result:**
  - the unit may shoot using **close-quarters shooting**
  - under any other **shooting type**, each of its models (**MONSTER/VEHICLE** excepted) picks 1× category to attack with: its **[CLOSE-QUARTERS]** weapons, or its other ranged weapons; one or more in the category

sharedRules.name: Support
sharedRules.description:
- **Timing:** Muster Armies step, pre-battle
- **Select:** per **leader** and **support** unit of your army, 1× friendly **bodyguard** unit it can lead (optional)
- **Result:** the pair forms an **attached** unit for the whole battle
  - unless stated otherwise, a **bodyguard** unit accepts ≤1 **leader** and ≤1 **support**
